convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom 'Go' indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close position functions, money management, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). The custom indicator's buffer values drive all signals.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of selected timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

long.direction: TrendValue[0]==2 AND TrendValue[1]==1 (trend shifts from 1 to 2 = bullish)

short.direction: TrendValue[0]==1 AND TrendValue[1]==2 (trend shifts from 2 to 1 = bearish)

other_exits: Signal-based close: if SellPosOpen AND SellPosClose AND TrendValue[1]==1 then close sell; if BuyPosOpen AND BuyPosClose AND TrendValue[1]==2 then close buy - this is an additional close-when-in-trend rule beyond reversal signals

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT (4) means fixed lot size of MM=0.1; other modes calculate lot as fraction of margin/balance per TradeAlgorithms.mqh money management: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: The Go custom indicator outputs discrete trend state values (1=bearish, 2=bullish) on buffer 1. Entry signals are trend-state transitions: 1->2 for buy, 2->1 for sell. Signal is evaluated at SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) with 2-value lookback for transition detection. When BuyPosOpen=true and BuyPosClose=true, an additional close signal fires when TrendValue[1]==2 (already in bullish trend) - this creates a close-on-re-entry pattern. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to last bar time + timeframe seconds, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution gating. The Recount static flag provides one retry on CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of: (1) the custom 'Go' indicator logic - must obtain its source or reverse-engineer from buffer outputs (trend state 1/2 on buffer 1, buffer 0 likely price line); (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ with all 5 money management modes. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - verify whether these need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10) since the EA does not explicitly adjust. Signal logic is straightforward: detect state transitions on completed bars only. The IsNewBar guard means Python implementation should use bar-level processing with a new-bar detection mechanism.
